A consistency checker would parse design claims and test them against conservation of energy/momentum, thermodynamics, relativity, and quantum limits. Rule-based prototypes are demonstrated on textbook cases. Status: simulated. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: simulated.

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Physics-Law Consistency Checker, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Claim parsing to physical assertions). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Claim parsing to physical assertions and Conservation-law test suite. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Impossible-Design Explorer) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: simulated.
